heroHeadline: Tbilisi Protests Pass 630 Days as Jailed Ex-PM Garibashvili Breaks With Ivanishvili
heroSubtitle: Daily demonstrations against Georgian Dream continue past their 633rd Saturday march as imprisoned former PM Irakli Garibashvili publicly accuses the government of pressuring him into a false corruption confession, an Adjara TV journalist who reported repeated attacks was himself detained, and seven UN Security Council members condemned Russia's occupation of Georgian territories on the 2008 war's 18th anniversary.
